annotations.title: Cheapest recent fares from a city, to a place or anywhere

description: Fare Deals. Cheapest recent fares from a city, to a place or anywhere. The say field is a ready-made answer.

country.description: Two-letter country for the currency, for example US, GB, CA, AU, DE. Leave out to use the traveller's location.

from.description: City or airport, for example New York or JFK. Add a state or country when a name is shared: Birmingham, UK; Birmingham, AL; Portland, Maine.

limit.description: How many deals to return, 1 to 20.

to.description: City or airport, or anywhere (default). Same state or country hints as from.
